title: Rav Tachlifa bar Avina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as a student of Rav Chisda, as in [Chullin 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.60b.8-9), where Rav Chisda said to him: “Write kanini and balistri — arunki in your aggadah book, and explain it.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara has two instructions to Rav Tachlifa bar Avina: first to write and explain קניגי ובליסטרי, then ארונקי. Hyman writes קניני and combines the instructions.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3546&lang=en) also cites Rav Chisda’s address to Rav Tachlifa at Chullin 60b. Hyman describes him as a student of Rav Chisda.
